baseline_source.note: Current-fixture baseline before the Darwin executable dispatch fix

notes.production_behavior: Darwin executable identity supplies launcher-home relaunch, selected-release forwarding and the internal Discord relaunch path. The same Darwin primitive locates graphics bundle resources.
notes.baseline: After bringing the synthetic routing fixture up to the unchanged current frontend admission contract, exactly the missing Darwin relaunch-path assertion and update-forwarding case fail before the dispatch change.
notes.fixture_repairs: The existing regression now copies frontend_runtime_selection.py and packaged_shader_defaults.py along with native_gameplay_test.py. Its newly generated synthetic frontend receipt declares the mandatory V3 loading profile and exact hashes of its synthetic resources. No real retained proof, cache or production admission rule changed.
notes.slice_selection: Actual universal launchers are lipo-verified for both architectures, then exact slices are extracted and signed inside the private build. Python-launched subprocesses therefore cannot accidentally pick native ARM while testing x86_64.
notes.path_api: The universal path test executes both slices through a relative Unicode symlink after relocation and after changing working directory. No argv0-derived path is accepted.
notes.scope: Actual launcher binaries and graphics execute; setup/runtime subprocesses in the routing regression are explicit synthetic recorders. No real MCC preparation, GUI runtime packaging, sign-in, entitlement, gameplay, physical Intel, release signing or notarization is established.
notes.next_boundary: Packaged tools/resources and writable imports/saves/settings still share the legacy installation-root model. Separate these owners and package the setup/UI runtime before shipping a self-contained Mac launcher.
